name: Jean-Loo Pissoir
source:
A French crapper (NOTE: "cool-rapper") with confidence out the wazoo. Always "on" and somewhat hard to approach, especially on an intimate/personal level. Jean will happily spit bars at whoever will listen, but he only respects those who can keep up with his verbal wit. Most of the other dateables have never heard him speak a full sentence without rhyming. Probably smells a little bit.
Likes: Rhymin', Spittin', Slingin', Winnin'
Dislikes: The Cold Reality That He Is In Fact a Toilet Above All.

[From the in-game Date-a-dex]
